name: Hajime
source:
[spoiler]True route 's protagonist.
Jouichi and Emi 's son.
He adopted by Kana after explosion incident at hospital happened in his birthday since Jouichi has been in a coma and can't contact Emi after incident.

10~ years later, He got work as Jouichi 's ghostwriter and written novel base on Jouichi 's summer live for reclaim Jouichi 's memories.[/spoiler]
translation:
[spoiler]True route 's protagonist.
Jouichi and Emi 's son.
He adopted by Kana after explosion incident at hospital happened in his birthday since Jouichi has been in a coma and can't contact Emi after incident.

10~ years later, He got work as Jouichi 's ghostwriter and written novel base on Jouichi 's summer live for reclaim Jouichi 's memories.[/spoiler]
